Class StockItem

java.lang.Object
frontend.models.StockItem
public class StockItem extends Object
This class represents a stock item with its properties and provides getters and setters for each property.

      public StockItem(int inventoryID, String name, int stock, int minStock, String nextShipment, String shelfLife)
      Creates a stock item with the supplied inventory details.
      Parameters:
      inventoryID - the inventory item's database ID
      name - the inventory item's name
      stock - the current stock quantity
      minStock - the minimum desired stock quantity
      nextShipment - the next shipment date or description
      shelfLife - the shelf life information for the item
